title: What Each Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Service Level Includes in the Home
content:
The six Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery service levels differ in where the team places the items, what it does once inside, how many people it sends and how the hand-over is recorded. The comparison below gives every level's terms.

## Placement and work in the home

| Service level | Where items are placed | Team unpacks and removes packaging | Basic assembly included | Assembly time included per booking | Floor coverings used inside the home | Two-person team |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | At the curb | No | No | Not applicable | No | No |
| Threshold Delivery | Inside the first door | No | No | Not applicable | No | Yes |
| Room of Choice Delivery | In the room of the customer's choice | No | No | Not applicable | Yes | Yes |
| White Glove Delivery | In the room of the customer's choice | Yes | No | Not applicable | Yes | Yes |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | In the room of the customer's choice | Yes | Yes | 60 minutes | Yes | Yes |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | In the room of the customer's choice | Yes | Yes | 90 minutes | Yes | Yes |

## Contact and hand-over

| Service level | Team calls before arrival | Items inspected with the customer before the team leaves | Signature collected on delivery | Contactless drop-off can be chosen |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | 30 minutes | No | No | Yes |
| Threshold Delivery | 30 minutes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Room of Choice Delivery | 30 minutes | Yes | Yes | No |
| White Glove Delivery | 30 minutes | Yes | Yes | No |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | 30 minutes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | 60 minutes | Yes | Yes | No |

## Reading the comparison

- **Assembly time** is the assembly time included per booking, in whole minutes; it is shown only for the two levels that include basic assembly and is not applicable to the others.
- **Call-ahead** is the number of minutes before arrival at which the team calls: 30 minutes at every level except Premier White Glove with Haul-Away, where it is 60 minutes.
- **Contactless drop-off** is a choice open to the customer only at Curbside Delivery and Threshold Delivery.

## Points of comparison

- Room of Choice Delivery and White Glove Delivery place items the same way; the difference in this comparison is that White Glove Delivery unpacks and removes packaging and Room of Choice Delivery does not.
- White Glove Delivery with Assembly and Premier White Glove with Haul-Away both include basic assembly; the included time is 60 minutes and 90 minutes respectively.
- Curbside Delivery is the only level that sends neither a two-person team nor collects a signature.
